displayForm: Oh, that's fantastic! She cares a lot about books, so it sounds like a great fit.

ru.translation: О, здорово! Она очень любит книги, так что ей это отлично подходит.
ru.usageNote: Learner reacts emotionally to Alex's specific news and adds a brief opinion with a reason.

examples.text: Oh, that's fantastic! She cares a lot about books, so it sounds like a great fit.

npcReplyCorrect: She was thrilled when she told me. The first event is meant to bring neighbours together.

displayForm: Have you heard whether the library will take part too? Their readers might enjoy it.

ru.translation: Ты слышал(а), будет ли библиотека тоже участвовать? Её читателям это может понравиться.
ru.usageNote: Present Perfect news question from frozen V2; follows from the reading event and adds a relevant follow-up.

examples.text: Have you heard whether the library will take part too? Their readers might enjoy it.

npcReplyCorrect: Maya said she invited the library team, but they haven't confirmed yet.

displayForm: I hope they can come. I think hearing different readers talk about books would make the evening more interesting.

ru.translation: Надеюсь, они смогут прийти. Думаю, разговоры разных читателей о книгах сделают вечер интереснее.
ru.usageNote: Builds on Alex's answer with a short opinion and a supporting reason.

examples.text: I hope they can come. I think hearing different readers talk about books would make the evening more interesting.

npcReplyCorrect: Me too. I'll ask Maya when she's planning the first discussion.

displayForm: Oh, that's exciting for Nina! Bristol could be a great change for her, especially with the new job.

ru.translation: О, я рад(а) за Нину! Переезд в Бристоль может стать для неё хорошим изменением, особенно с новой работой.
ru.usageNote: Practice variation transfers the response pattern to personal news about a friend's move.

examples.text: Oh, that's exciting for Nina! Bristol could be a great change for her, especially with the new job.

npcReplyCorrect: She is looking forward to the job, though she'll miss her friends here.

displayForm: Oh, that's a shame. The smaller library events are really useful for people who can't get into town.

ru.translation: Как жаль. Небольшие библиотечные встречи очень полезны тем, кто не может добраться до центра.
ru.usageNote: Practice variation changes the news to a mildly negative community change and requires a softer reaction.

examples.text: Oh, that's a shame. The smaller library events are really useful for people who can't get into town.

npcReplyCorrect: They haven't decided about the Saturday group yet. Maya hopes it can stay because a lot of families go then.

displayForm: Have you heard if they could move one event to the community hall? It might be easier for everyone.

ru.translation: Ты слышал(а), могут ли они перенести одну встречу в общественный зал? Так, возможно, всем будет удобнее.
ru.usageNote: Follows the new constraint with a relevant question and a tentative suggestion.

examples.text: Have you heard if they could move one event to the community hall? It might be easier for everyone.

npcReplyCorrect: I'll check with the organiser. The hall is free on Thursday evenings.

displayForm: I see what you mean, but the music makes the market feel welcoming. A lot of families arrive after work and stay to listen.

ru.translation: Понимаю, что ты имеешь в виду, но музыка создаёт на ярмарке гостеприимную атмосферу. Многие семьи приходят после работы и остаются послушать.
ru.usageNote: Acknowledges Alex's concern, then states a different view and gives a reason.

examples.text: I see what you mean, but the music makes the market feel welcoming. A lot of families arrive after work and stay to listen.

npcReplyCorrect: That's fair, although the stalls say people stay longer when the music is on.

displayForm: I'm not sure I agree that it needs to stop so early. We could lower the volume after seven; that might keep it comfortable for everyone.

ru.translation: Не уверен(а), что музыку нужно выключать так рано. После семи можно сделать её тише — возможно, так всем будет комфортно.
ru.usageNote: Maintains disagreement politely and uses could/might as modal softeners.

examples.text: I'm not sure I agree that it needs to stop so early. We could lower the volume after seven; that might keep it comfortable for everyone.

npcReplyCorrect: Maybe. But people who live beside the square still need a quiet evening.

displayForm: That's true. Perhaps the music could stay near the main entrance, farther from the houses. Then the stalls can keep it, and residents get a quieter street.

ru.translation: Это правда. Возможно, музыку можно оставить у главного входа, подальше от домов. Тогда она останется у торговых рядов, а на улице будет тише.
ru.usageNote: Recognises Alex's concern without abandoning the learner's position and offers a reasoned compromise.

examples.text: That's true. Perhaps the music could stay near the main entrance, farther from the houses. Then the stalls can keep it, and residents get a quieter street.

npcReplyCorrect: That sounds workable. I'll suggest trying it for one month and asking the neighbours what they think.

displayForm: I don't think the six o'clock start will work for everyone, though I see why you'd choose it. A later start could let more neighbours join.

ru.translation: Не думаю, что начало в шесть подойдёт всем, хотя я понимаю, почему ты выбираешь раннее время. Если начать позже, смогут прийти и другие соседи.
ru.usageNote: Variation changes the issue from a personal opinion to a practical event plan; I don't think is an explicit softened-opinion chunk.

examples.text: I don't think the six o'clock start will work for everyone, though I see why you'd choose it. A later start could let more neighbours join.

npcReplyCorrect: I hadn't thought about the people coming from work. What time would you suggest?

displayForm: I'm not sure about cancelling the outdoor film. The forecast could improve, and we could keep the hall as a backup.

ru.translation: Я не уверен(а) насчёт отмены фильма под открытым небом. Прогноз может улучшиться, а зал можно оставить запасным вариантом.
ru.usageNote: Variation changes the topic to an event plan; modal softeners express a reasoned alternative.

examples.text: I'm not sure about cancelling the outdoor film. The forecast could improve, and we could keep the hall as a backup.

npcReplyCorrect: The forecast has been poor all week, and the equipment is expensive to move at the last minute.

displayForm: I understand, and I agree we need to protect the equipment. We might wait until Friday morning to decide; that gives us time to check the forecast.

ru.translation: Понимаю и согласен(на), что оборудование нужно беречь. Возможно, решим в пятницу утром — будет время проверить прогноз.
ru.usageNote: After Alex pushes back again, learner keeps the position respectfully and offers a practical condition.

examples.text: I understand, and I agree we need to protect the equipment. We might wait until Friday morning to decide; that gives us time to check the forecast.

npcReplyCorrect: That's a sensible middle ground. I'll ask the team to hold the hall until then.

displayForm: The ginger iced tea is lighter and less sweet than the vanilla cold brew, so it may suit more people on a warm day.

ru.translation: Имбирный холодный чай легче и менее сладкий, чем ванильный кофе холодного заваривания, поэтому в тёплый день он подойдёт большему числу людей.
ru.usageNote: Compares the two drinks and supports the recommendation with a reason.

examples.text: The ginger iced tea is lighter and less sweet than the vanilla cold brew, so it may suit more people on a warm day.

npcReplyCorrect: That makes sense. The cold brew is popular with guests who like a richer drink.

displayForm: I prefer the ginger tea for the board because it's refreshing but not too strong. If I were you, I'd recommend it with the lemon cake.

ru.translation: Для доски я предпочитаю имбирный чай: он освежающий, но не слишком крепкий. На твоём месте я бы рекомендовала его с лимонным пирогом.
ru.usageNote: States and explains a preference; `If I were you...` is an explicit lexical chunk, not a Second Conditional target.

examples.text: I prefer the ginger tea for the board because it's refreshing but not too strong. If I were you, I'd recommend it with the lemon cake.

npcReplyCorrect: Nice pairing. Would you mention who might prefer the cold brew?

displayForm: Maybe add a note that the cold brew is for people who like a stronger taste. That gives customers a choice.

ru.translation: Можно добавить, что холодный кофе подойдёт тем, кто любит более насыщенный вкус. Так у посетителей будет выбор.
ru.usageNote: Responds to Maya's follow-up by giving a second supported recommendation rather than repeating the first.

examples.text: Maybe add a note that the cold brew is for people who like a stronger taste. That gives customers a choice.

npcReplyCorrect: Good idea. I'll put both options on the board with those notes.

displayForm: The mushroom toast would be a better lunch choice than the cheese scone; it's more filling and still works with soup.

ru.translation: Грибной тост лучше подойдёт на обед, чем сырная булочка: он сытнее и сочетается с супом.
ru.usageNote: Variation transfers the comparison and supported recommendation from drinks to food.

examples.text: The mushroom toast would be a better lunch choice than the cheese scone; it's more filling and still works with soup.

npcReplyCorrect: I hadn't thought of serving it with soup. I'll try that as the lunch suggestion.

displayForm: The oat bar is cheaper than the fruit bowl, but the fruit bowl feels fresher. For a light afternoon snack, I'd choose the fruit.

ru.translation: Овсяный батончик дешевле фруктовой тарелки, но фрукты кажутся свежее. Для лёгкого перекуса днём я бы выбрал(а) фрукты.
ru.usageNote: Variation changes the recommendation domain and requires weighing price against freshness before choosing.

examples.text: The oat bar is cheaper than the fruit bowl, but the fruit bowl feels fresher. For a light afternoon snack, I'd choose the fruit.

npcReplyCorrect: That's helpful. I'll list both and mark the fruit bowl as the lighter option.

displayForm: I have a serious nut allergy. Does the lentil pie contain any nuts?

ru.translation: У меня сильная аллергия на орехи. В пироге с чечевицей есть орехи?
ru.usageNote: Learner names the restriction and asks a precise present-simple question about an ingredient.

examples.text: I have a serious nut allergy. Does the lentil pie contain any nuts?

npcReplyCorrect: No nuts are listed, but I'll check the full ingredient sheet with the kitchen before I say it's safe.

displayForm: Could you make sure they use a clean pan as well? Even a small amount could be a problem for me.

ru.translation: Не могли бы вы также убедиться, что они используют чистую сковороду? Даже небольшое количество может быть для меня опасным.
ru.usageNote: Could you make sure is a fixed polite chunk; learner explains why cross-contact matters.

examples.text: Could you make sure they use a clean pan as well? Even a small amount could be a problem for me.

npcReplyCorrect: Of course. I'll mark the order clearly and speak to the chef myself; I'll come back once they've checked.

displayForm: Thanks. Could you confirm that the chef checked the sauce too, not just the pie?

ru.translation: Спасибо. Подтвердите, пожалуйста, что повар проверил и соус, а не только пирог?
ru.usageNote: Learner verifies a specific second component without repeating the original restriction.

examples.text: Thanks. Could you confirm that the chef checked the sauce too, not just the pie?

npcReplyCorrect: Yes. The sauce is made separately, and the chef has confirmed both it and the clean pan are suitable.

displayForm: I don't eat meat, but it's a preference rather than an allergy. Does the mushroom pie contain any meat stock?

ru.translation: Я не ем мясо, но это предпочтение, а не аллергия. В грибном пироге есть мясной бульон?
ru.usageNote: Transfers ingredient-checking to a vegetarian preference and distinguishes it accurately from an allergy.

examples.text: I don't eat meat, but it's a preference rather than an allergy. Does the mushroom pie contain any meat stock?

npcReplyCorrect: It does contain beef stock, so that pie isn't suitable for your preference. The vegetable tart is made without meat stock.

displayForm: I can't have sesame. Could you check both the flatbread and the dressing, please?

ru.translation: Мне нельзя кунжут. Проверьте, пожалуйста, и лепёшку, и заправку?
ru.usageNote: Transfers the restriction to two separate components, requiring the learner to make the scope explicit.

examples.text: I can't have sesame. Could you check both the flatbread and the dressing, please?

npcReplyCorrect: The flatbread contains sesame seeds, but the dressing doesn't. I'll ask the kitchen to bring a different side.

displayForm: We've been waiting for the main course for almost an hour, and nobody has told us what's happening.

ru.translation: Мы ждём основное блюдо почти час, и нам никто не сказал, что происходит.
ru.usageNote: Present Perfect Continuous is an explicit fixed complaint chunk, not a grammar target.

examples.text: We've been waiting for the main course for almost an hour, and nobody has told us what's happening.

npcReplyCorrect: I'm sorry. I can see the delay, but I was told the kitchen was finishing your order. Let me check what went wrong.

displayForm: When it arrived, it was the wrong dish, so this isn't what I expected after such a long wait.

ru.translation: Когда его принесли, это оказалось не то блюдо, поэтому после такого долгого ожидания я ожидал(а) другого.
ru.usageNote: Adds a specific, distinct service failure instead of repeating the delay.

examples.text: When it arrived, it was the wrong dish, so this isn't what I expected after such a long wait.

npcReplyCorrect: You're right; the ticket says grilled fish, not the chicken pasta. I can have the correct meal prepared now.

displayForm: I appreciate that, but the delay has affected our evening. What can you do about the bill?

ru.translation: Спасибо, но из-за задержки пострадал весь наш вечер. Что вы можете сделать со счётом?
ru.usageNote: Learner asks for a specific remedy after stating the practical impact.

examples.text: I appreciate that, but the delay has affected our evening. What can you do about the bill?

npcReplyCorrect: I should have checked on your table earlier. I'll remove the drinks from the bill and bring the correct main course straight away.

displayForm: We've been waiting a long time, and the meal that came is not what we ordered. Could you replace it and check the bill?

ru.translation: Мы долго ждали, а принесённое блюдо не совпадает с заказом. Замените его и проверьте счёт, пожалуйста.
ru.usageNote: Transfers complaint from a delayed meal to a wrong order and requests two concrete actions.

examples.text: We've been waiting a long time, and the meal that came is not what we ordered. Could you replace it and check the bill?

npcReplyCorrect: I can see we brought the vegetable pie instead of the fish. I'll replace it and correct the bill.

lemma: report a cold meal and a long wait before the server responds
displayForm: The main course is cold, and we have been waiting nearly an hour. Could you check what happened?

ru.translation: Основное блюдо холодное, а мы ждём почти час. Проверьте, пожалуйста, что произошло?
ru.usageNote: Variation v2 first reports the cold meal and long wait. Leo then initially pushes back in npcReplyCorrect; the following variation turn calmly holds the position.

examples.text: The main course is cold, and we have been waiting nearly an hour. Could you check what happened?

npcReplyCorrect: I'm sorry, but the kitchen has been very busy, and the server brought it as soon as it was ready.

displayForm: My train has been cancelled, and I need to get to Northbridge before six. What are my options?

ru.translation: Мой поезд отменили, и мне нужно попасть в Нортбридж до шести. Какие у меня есть варианты?
ru.usageNote: Has been cancelled is a fixed Present Perfect Passive lexical chunk, not a grammar target.

examples.text: My train has been cancelled, and I need to get to Northbridge before six. What are my options?

npcReplyCorrect: The direct service is cancelled because of a signal problem. There is a replacement bus at quarter past four, and another train via Central at twenty past four.

displayForm: The bus is direct, but it may be slow in traffic. I'll take the train via Central because it gets me there earlier.

ru.translation: Автобус идёт напрямую, но из-за пробок он может ехать медленно. Поеду поездом через Сентрал, потому что так я доберусь раньше.
ru.usageNote: Learner compares two real options and gives a reason for the choice.

examples.text: The bus is direct, but it may be slow in traffic. I'll take the train via Central because it gets me there earlier.

npcReplyCorrect: That train leaves from platform five. Your ticket is still valid, so go to the platform desk if the gate doesn't accept it.

displayForm: Thanks. Is platform five the one beside the coffee shop, and do I need to change at Central?

ru.translation: Спасибо. Пятая платформа рядом с кофейней? И нужно ли мне пересаживаться в Сентрале?
ru.usageNote: Learner checks the practical steps needed to follow the chosen alternative.

examples.text: Thanks. Is platform five the one beside the coffee shop, and do I need to change at Central?

npcReplyCorrect: Yes, it's next to the coffee shop, and you can stay on the same train all the way to Northbridge.

displayForm: The train is delayed by fifty minutes, and I'll miss my connection. Is there another way to get to Northbridge before six?

ru.translation: Поезд задерживается на пятьдесят минут, и я опоздаю на пересадку. Есть другой способ попасть в Нортбридж до шести?
ru.usageNote: Variation changes the disruption from cancellation to a delay that causes a missed connection.

examples.text: The train is delayed by fifty minutes, and I'll miss my connection. Is there another way to get to Northbridge before six?

npcReplyCorrect: You could take the express to Westfield and change there. It usually reaches Northbridge just before six.

displayForm: The bus takes longer but goes straight there; the train is quicker but needs a change. I'll take the bus because I have heavy luggage.

ru.translation: Автобус едет дольше, зато без пересадки; поезд быстрее, но нужна пересадка. Выберу автобус, потому что у меня тяжёлый багаж.
ru.usageNote: Variation offers two options with distinct trade-offs; learner chooses and justifies one.

examples.text: The bus takes longer but goes straight there; the train is quicker but needs a change. I'll take the bus because I have heavy luggage.

npcReplyCorrect: Good choice. The bus stop is outside the station, and the driver can put your case underneath.

lemma: hold a polite position after the server pushes back
displayForm: I understand you were busy, but we still waited nearly an hour and the meal was cold. Could you remove it from the bill?

ru.translation: Понимаю, что вы были заняты, но мы всё равно ждали почти час, и блюдо было холодным. Уберите его из счёта, пожалуйста.
ru.usageNote: The learner acknowledges Leo’s explanation, restates the evidence and asks for a specific remedy without becoming rude.

examples.text: I understand you were busy, but we still waited nearly an hour and the meal was cold. Could you remove it from the bill?

npcReplyCorrect: That's fair. I'll take the cold meal off the bill and bring you a fresh one if you'd still like it.

displayForm: What would you suggest seeing first? I'm interested in local history, but I don't want to spend the whole day indoors.

ru.translation: Что вы посоветуете посмотреть сначала? Мне интересна местная история, но я не хочу провести весь день в помещении.
ru.usageNote: Asks for a useful first stop and gives a preference that Rosa can use.

examples.text: What would you suggest seeing first? I'm interested in local history, but I don't want to spend the whole day indoors.

npcReplyCorrect: The small city museum is a good start. After that, the canal path is nearby and mostly outdoors.

displayForm: The museum is closer than the riverside path, but is the riverside walk worth doing this afternoon?

ru.translation: Музей ближе, чем набережная, но стоит ли сегодня прогуляться вдоль реки?
ru.usageNote: Evidence for recycled comparatives and the real B1 target worth + -ing; evaluates the walk against the learner's preference.

examples.text: The museum is closer than the riverside path, but is the riverside walk worth doing this afternoon?

npcReplyCorrect: Yes. The path takes about thirty-five minutes, and you can turn back at the old bridge if you need to.

displayForm: Then I'll walk along the canal first and visit the museum afterwards if I have time. How long does it take to get back to the station?

ru.translation: Тогда сначала пройдусь вдоль канала, а потом зайду в музей, если останется время. Сколько идти обратно до вокзала?
ru.usageNote: Turns the advice into a feasible order and checks the return time.

examples.text: Then I'll walk along the canal first and visit the museum afterwards if I have time. How long does it take to get back to the station?

npcReplyCorrect: It's about twenty minutes from the museum entrance, or thirty from the far end of the canal path.

displayForm: I'm hungry before my train. Is the covered market worth trying for lunch, and what local dish would you recommend that is quick?

ru.translation: Я проголодался(ась) перед поездом. Стоит ли зайти пообедать на крытый рынок и какое местное блюдо вы посоветуете, чтобы быстро перекусить?
ru.usageNote: Transfers the recommendation/evaluation function from sightseeing to local food and asks for a reasoned, time-sensitive choice.

examples.text: I'm hungry before my train. Is the covered market worth trying for lunch, and what local dish would you recommend that is quick?

npcReplyCorrect: The market café is worth a visit. Try their vegetable soup; they serve it quickly.

displayForm: I have only two hours before my train. The museum and canal path both sound good; is it worth trying both, or should I choose one? Which would you recommend first?

ru.translation: До поезда у меня всего два часа. И музей, и канал звучат заманчиво; стоит ли успевать оба места или лучше выбрать одно? Что вы посоветуете сначала?
ru.usageNote: Transfers route planning to a strict time limit and requires evaluating what fits instead of repeating an unconstrained itinerary.

examples.text: I have only two hours before my train. The museum and canal path both sound good; is it worth trying both, or should I choose one? Which would you recommend first?

npcReplyCorrect: With two hours, I'd choose the museum and the short canal section near the bridge. You'll have time to return without rushing.

displayForm: I've had one trip I'll never forget. I went to York on my own for a weekend when I was at college.

ru.translation: У меня была поездка, которую я никогда не забуду. Во время учёбы в колледже я один(одна) съездил(а) на выходные в Йорк.
ru.usageNote: Present Perfect introduces life experience without a finished-time marker; Past Simple starts its narrative details.

examples.text: I've had one trip I'll never forget. I went to York on my own for a weekend when I was at college.

npcReplyCorrect: What happened on the first day?

displayForm: I took the wrong bus and ended up outside the city. It started to rain, so I went into a small café and asked for directions.

ru.translation: Я сел(а) не на тот автобус и оказался(ась) за городом. Начался дождь, поэтому я зашёл(зашла) в маленькое кафе и спросил(а), как пройти.
ru.usageNote: Connected Past Simple events develop the middle of the story with clear cause and response.

examples.text: I took the wrong bus and ended up outside the city. It started to rain, so I went into a small café and asked for directions.

npcReplyCorrect: That sounds stressful, especially on your own. Did someone help you find your way back?

displayForm: The owner drew me a map, and I got back just in time for a walking tour. I was late, but the guide waited for me. I'll never forget how kind they were.

ru.translation: Хозяин нарисовал мне карту, и я успел(а) вернуться как раз к пешей экскурсии. Я опоздал(а), но гид меня дождался. Никогда не забуду, как добры они были.
ru.usageNote: Finishes the narrative with a resolution and reflection; I'll never forget is a fixed chunk.

examples.text: The owner drew me a map, and I got back just in time for a walking tour. I was late, but the guide waited for me. I'll never forget how kind they were.

npcReplyCorrect: That was kind of them. It sounds like the unexpected stop became the best part of the trip.

displayForm: I've made one travel mistake I still laugh about. I booked a room in Bath, but went to the wrong hotel because there were two hotels with very similar names.

ru.translation: Я совершил(а) одну дорожную ошибку, над которой до сих пор смеюсь. Я забронировал(а) комнату в Бате, но приехал(а) не в тот отель, потому что два отеля назывались очень похоже.
ru.usageNote: Variation changes the emotional tone from a memorable highlight to a mistake; Present Perfect introduces it and Past Simple narrates it.

examples.text: I've made one travel mistake I still laugh about. I booked a room in Bath, but went to the wrong hotel because there were two hotels with very similar names.

npcReplyCorrect: Oh no, that sounds confusing. How did you find the right place?

displayForm: I showed the receptionist my booking email. She called the other hotel, and a taxi took me there in ten minutes.

ru.translation: Я показал(а) администратору письмо с бронированием. Она позвонила во второй отель, и такси отвезло меня туда за десять минут.
ru.usageNote: Completes the variation as a connected problem-and-resolution story in Past Simple.

examples.text: I showed the receptionist my booking email. She called the other hotel, and a taxi took me there in ten minutes.

npcReplyCorrect: I'm glad they sorted it out quickly. I can see why you still remember it.

displayForm: I've had a weekend I'll always remember. I helped at a street festival: first the singer's car broke down, and then heavy rain started just before the show. We moved everything into the library hall and the audience came with us.

ru.translation: У меня были выходные, которые я всегда буду помнить. Я помогал(а) на уличном фестивале: сначала сломалась машина певца, а затем прямо перед выступлением пошёл сильный дождь. Мы перенесли всё в библиотечный зал, и зрители пошли за нами.
ru.usageNote: Variation contains two connected setbacks and a resolution, requiring sequencing across more than one event.

examples.text: I've had a weekend I'll always remember. I helped at a street festival: first the singer's car broke down, and then heavy rain started just before the show. We moved everything into the library hall and the audience came with us.

npcReplyCorrect: You had to change the whole plan at the last minute. Did the show still go ahead?

displayForm: I used to live near the old market, but now I rent a flat beside my office. I moved because the bus ride took nearly an hour each way.

ru.translation: Раньше я жил(а) рядом со старым рынком, а теперь снимаю квартиру рядом с офисом. Я переехал(а), потому что дорога на автобусе занимала почти час в одну сторону.
ru.usageNote: The used to target contrasts a former state with the present and gives a clear reason for the change.

examples.text: I used to live near the old market, but now I rent a flat beside my office. I moved because the bus ride took nearly an hour each way.

npcReplyCorrect: That is a big difference. What else changed in your everyday routine after the move?

displayForm: I used to spend most evenings at home, but now I walk along the river on my way back. It helps me relax after work.

ru.translation: Раньше я почти все вечера проводил(а) дома, а теперь по дороге обратно гуляю вдоль реки. Это помогает мне отдохнуть после работы.
ru.usageNote: Extends the comparison from location to a changed habit and explains its present benefit.

examples.text: I used to spend most evenings at home, but now I walk along the river on my way back. It helps me relax after work.

npcReplyCorrect: That sounds like a good way to finish the day. Do you go even when the weather is not ideal?

displayForm: The change happened slowly. At first I walked once a week, then twice, and now I go almost every day. I realised I sleep better when I get some fresh air.

ru.translation: Перемены происходили постепенно. Сначала я гулял(а) раз в неделю, потом два, а теперь почти каждый день. Я понял(а), что лучше сплю, когда бываю на свежем воздухе.
ru.usageNote: Variation v2 makes the change gradual and shows stages, rather than swapping one habit noun.

examples.text: The change happened slowly. At first I walked once a week, then twice, and now I go almost every day. I realised I sleep better when I get some fresh air.

npcReplyCorrect: It makes sense that you kept doing it once you noticed the difference.

displayForm: I used to read the news on my phone during the bus ride, but now I listen to a podcast instead. I wanted a break from looking at a screen.

ru.translation: Раньше я читал(а) новости в телефоне в автобусе, а теперь вместо этого слушаю подкаст. Мне захотелось отдохнуть от экрана.
ru.usageNote: Variation changes the change from location/after-work routine to a travel habit and states its cause.

examples.text: I used to read the news on my phone during the bus ride, but now I listen to a podcast instead. I wanted a break from looking at a screen.

npcReplyCorrect: That sounds like a useful change. Do you listen to the same kind of programme each day?

displayForm: I used to drive to work every day. The change was gradual: I started cycling on Fridays, then added another day, and now I cycle most of the week.

ru.translation: Раньше я каждый день ездил(а) на работу на машине. Перемены шли постепенно: сначала я стал(а) ездить на велосипеде по пятницам, потом добавил(а) ещё один день, а теперь езжу так большую часть недели.
ru.usageNote: Variation v2 changes the domain to commuting and expresses a gradual multi-stage shift with the same used to target.

examples.text: I used to drive to work every day. The change was gradual: I started cycling on Fridays, then added another day, and now I cycle most of the week.

npcReplyCorrect: That is quite a change. What made you decide to keep cycling more often?

displayForm: There are two charges for the same month on my bill. I was charged twice for my music subscription.

ru.translation: В моём счёте два списания за один и тот же месяц. С меня дважды списали плату за музыкальную подписку.
ru.usageNote: The learner opens with the concrete billing evidence and the frozen V2 past-passive target.

examples.text: There are two charges for the same month on my bill. I was charged twice for my music subscription.

npcReplyCorrect: I can see both payments on the account. Were they taken on the same date?

displayForm: Yes, they were both taken on 3 May, but my plan should only be billed once a month.

ru.translation: Да, оба списания были 3 мая, но по моему тарифу плата должна списываться только раз в месяц.
ru.usageNote: Adds requested evidence without repeating the opening complaint; should only is recycled service language.

examples.text: Yes, they were both taken on 3 May, but my plan should only be billed once a month.

npcReplyCorrect: You're right. One is the monthly payment and the other appears to be a duplicate. Do you want me to check how it happened?

lemma: ask a service agent to investigate
displayForm: Yes, can you look into this? I don't want the same problem on next month's bill.

ru.translation: Да, можете разобраться? Я не хочу, чтобы такая же проблема появилась в счёте за следующий месяц.
ru.usageNote: Can you look into this? is an explicit service-resolution lexical chunk, not another grammar lesson.

examples.text: Yes, can you look into this? I don't want the same problem on next month's bill.

npcReplyCorrect: The renewal was processed twice by mistake. I can refund the extra payment today and remove the duplicate renewal.

lemma: request and confirm a billing resolution
displayForm: Please refund the extra payment and remove the duplicate renewal. I'd like this fixed before my next bill.

ru.translation: Пожалуйста, верните лишний платёж и удалите повторное продление. Я хочу, чтобы это исправили до следующего счёта.
ru.usageNote: The learner chooses the concrete remedy; I'd like this fixed is classified as a lexical service chunk.

examples.text: Please refund the extra payment and remove the duplicate renewal. I'd like this fixed before my next bill.

npcReplyCorrect: Done. The refund will appear within three working days, and your account now has only one monthly renewal.

lemma: challenge a charge for the wrong subscription tier
displayForm: I signed up for the basic plan, but I was charged for the premium plan this month. Can you change the account and refund the difference?

ru.translation: Я оформил(а) базовый тариф, но в этом месяце с меня списали плату за премиум-тариф. Можете изменить тариф и вернуть разницу?
ru.usageNote: Variation v1 transfers the same passive complaint and resolution skill to a wrong subscription tier.

examples.text: I signed up for the basic plan, but I was charged for the premium plan this month. Can you change the account and refund the difference?

npcReplyCorrect: I can see the wrong tier on the account. I'll move you to the basic plan now and refund the difference.

lemma: follow up on an unresolved billing issue
displayForm: I called on Monday about a duplicate charge and was told it would be removed, but it is still on my bill. Could you check the case and tell me when it will be fixed?

ru.translation: Я звонил(а) в понедельник по поводу повторного списания, и мне сказали, что его удалят, но оно всё ещё есть в счёте. Можете проверить обращение и сказать, когда проблему исправят?
ru.usageNote: Variation v2 adds persistence after an earlier call and requires a dated, case-specific follow-up.

examples.text: I called on Monday about a duplicate charge and was told it would be removed, but it is still on my bill. Could you check the case and tell me when it will be fixed?

npcReplyCorrect: I found Monday's case. The refund was approved but not sent, so I've released it now and emailed you the confirmation.

displayForm: I need something light for travel, but the screen also needs to be large enough for work.

ru.translation: Мне нужно что-то лёгкое для поездок, но экран также должен быть достаточно большим для работы.
ru.usageNote: The learner gives two real decision criteria before comparing products.

examples.text: I need something light for travel, but the screen also needs to be large enough for work.

npcReplyCorrect: The blue tablet is lighter, while the grey one has a larger screen. Would you like to compare the prices too?

displayForm: Compared to the grey tablet, the blue one is lighter, but the grey one has the larger screen.

ru.translation: По сравнению с серым планшетом синий легче, но у серого экран больше.
ru.usageNote: The learner reformulates the two feature differences rather than repeating Emma's wording exactly.

examples.text: Compared to the grey tablet, the blue one is lighter, but the grey one has the larger screen.

npcReplyCorrect: Exactly. The blue one is also cheaper, but the grey model has our longest battery life.

displayForm: The blue one is cheaper, but the grey one has the best battery life. I'd rather pay more for that on long trips.

ru.translation: Синий дешевле, но у серого самое долгое время работы от батареи. Для долгих поездок я предпочту заплатить за это больше.
ru.usageNote: Evidences the frozen comparative, superlative and would rather targets in one reasoned trade-off.

examples.text: The blue one is cheaper, but the grey one has the best battery life. I'd rather pay more for that on long trips.

npcReplyCorrect: That makes sense if you travel often. The grey one also includes a two-year guarantee. Which one will you choose?

lemma: make and justify a final product choice
displayForm: I'll take the grey one because it is better for long work trips, even though it costs more.

ru.translation: Я возьму серый, потому что он лучше подходит для долгих рабочих поездок, хотя и стоит дороже.
ru.usageNote: Closes the decision with a reason linked to the learner's opening priorities.

examples.text: I'll take the grey one because it is better for long work trips, even though it costs more.

npcReplyCorrect: Good choice. I'll bring you a new grey one from the stockroom and add the guarantee details.

displayForm: The monthly service is cheaper and easier to cancel, while the yearly service gives me more offline downloads. I'd rather pay monthly because my travel schedule changes.

ru.translation: Ежемесячная услуга дешевле, и её легче отменить, а годовая даёт больше загрузок для просмотра без интернета. Я предпочту платить ежемесячно, потому что мой график поездок меняется.
ru.usageNote: Variation v1 transfers comparison and preference from physical products to service terms.

examples.text: The monthly service is cheaper and easier to cancel, while the yearly service gives me more offline downloads. I'd rather pay monthly because my travel schedule changes.

npcReplyCorrect: The monthly plan fits that priority. You can still switch to the yearly service later if your schedule becomes more regular.

lemma: compare three bags under a travel constraint
displayForm: The small bag is the cheapest, the black one is stronger, and the green one is the lightest. I'd rather choose the black one because it protects my laptop and still fits under the seat.

ru.translation: Маленькая сумка самая дешёвая, чёрная прочнее, а зелёная самая лёгкая. Я предпочту чёрную, потому что она защищает ноутбук и всё же помещается под сиденьем.
ru.usageNote: Variation v2 raises complexity to three options and requires a constraint-based choice, not a noun swap.

examples.text: The small bag is the cheapest, the black one is stronger, and the green one is the lightest. I'd rather choose the black one because it protects my laptop and still fits under the seat.

npcReplyCorrect: The black bag is the best match for those two needs. It also comes with a cover for wet weather.

displayForm: What I need is a final guest list for Friday's event. Please check every name and contact detail.

ru.translation: Мне нужен окончательный список гостей для пятничного мероприятия. Пожалуйста, проверь каждое имя и контактные данные.
ru.usageNote: The task begins with a concrete deliverable and the frozen need + noun target.

examples.text: What I need is a final guest list for Friday's event. Please check every name and contact detail.

npcReplyCorrect: All right. Which file should I use as the main list?

lemma: explain the task source and update step
displayForm: Use the registration file as the main list. You also need to add any changes from yesterday's emails.

ru.translation: Используй файл регистрации как основной список. Также нужно добавить все изменения из вчерашних писем.
ru.usageNote: Adds the source and an action with need + infinitive; Daniel's next question moves to timing.

examples.text: Use the registration file as the main list. You also need to add any changes from yesterday's emails.

npcReplyCorrect: Got it. I have the file and the email folder. When do you need the completed list?

lemma: give a task deadline and reason
displayForm: I need the completed list by the end of Thursday so I can send it to reception before they close.

ru.translation: Мне нужен готовый список к концу четверга, чтобы я успел(а) отправить его на стойку регистрации до закрытия.
ru.usageNote: Evidences both frozen targets: need + noun and the deadline expression by the end of.

examples.text: I need the completed list by the end of Thursday so I can send it to reception before they close.

npcReplyCorrect: Thursday is fine. What should I do if a phone number is missing?

lemma: clarify an exception and check understanding
displayForm: Mark any missing phone numbers in yellow instead of guessing. Does that make sense?

ru.translation: Отметь все отсутствующие номера телефонов жёлтым цветом, а не пытайся угадать. Понятно?
ru.usageNote: The learner explains an exception and checks understanding; Does that make sense? is a workplace lexical chunk.

examples.text: Mark any missing phone numbers in yellow instead of guessing. Does that make sense?

npcReplyCorrect: Yes. I'll check the registration file and emails, mark missing numbers in yellow, and send you the list by Thursday afternoon.

lemma: hand over a document editing task
displayForm: What I need is a two-page summary of the survey. Use the final results, explain the three main findings, and send me the document by the end of Wednesday.

ru.translation: Мне нужно двухстраничное резюме опроса. Используй окончательные результаты, объясни три главных вывода и пришли мне документ к концу среды.
ru.usageNote: Variation v1 transfers the task hand-off from a project step to a document with its own content requirements.

examples.text: What I need is a two-page summary of the survey. Use the final results, explain the three main findings, and send me the document by the end of Wednesday.

npcReplyCorrect: Understood. I'll keep it to two pages, cover the three main findings, and send it on Wednesday afternoon.

lemma: explain a task fully without visual cues
displayForm: Since you can't see the project board, I'll explain the task fully. Open the folder called June Launch, check the budget sheet against the three supplier emails, and send me a list of any differences by the end of today.

ru.translation: Поскольку ты не видишь доску проекта, я полностью объясню задачу. Открой папку June Launch, сверь таблицу бюджета с тремя письмами поставщиков и пришли мне список всех расхождений к концу дня.
ru.usageNote: Phone variation removes pointing and visual context; folder name, file, sources, output and deadline must all be verbalised.

examples.text: Since you can't see the project board, I'll explain the task fully. Open the folder called June Launch, check the budget sheet against the three supplier emails, and send me a list of any differences by the end of today.

npcReplyCorrect: Let me check: June Launch folder, budget sheet against three supplier emails, then a list of differences by the end of today. That's clear.

lemma: ask a colleague to check room bookings
displayForm: Would you mind checking the room bookings while I update the guest list?

ru.translation: Не мог(ла) бы ты проверить бронирование комнат, пока я обновляю список гостей?
ru.usageNote: The opening request uses the frozen Would you mind + -ing target for a specific workplace favour.

examples.text: Would you mind checking the room bookings while I update the guest list?

npcReplyCorrect: I can check them after I finish the event schedule. Which details do you need me to confirm?

lemma: specify the favour and show appreciation
displayForm: Could you confirm the room names and times against the booking emails? I'd really appreciate it.

ru.translation: Можешь сверить названия комнат и время с письмами о бронировании? Я буду очень признателен(на).
ru.usageNote: Could you and I'd really appreciate it are recycled/fixed politeness chunks supporting the new target.

examples.text: Could you confirm the room names and times against the booking emails? I'd really appreciate it.

npcReplyCorrect: Of course. I should finish my schedule at eleven, so I can check the emails then. When do you need the corrections?

lemma: agree a realistic deadline for a favour
displayForm: Before one would be perfect, but only if it's not too much trouble. That gives me time to contact reception.

ru.translation: До часу было бы идеально, но только если это не доставит слишком много хлопот. Тогда у меня останется время связаться со стойкой регистрации.
ru.usageNote: Only if it's not too much trouble is the frozen politeness chunk; the learner accepts Daniel's timing instead of repeating the request.

examples.text: Before one would be perfect, but only if it's not too much trouble. That gives me time to contact reception.

npcReplyCorrect: That works. I'll send you the checked list before one and flag anything that needs a call.

lemma: ask a scheduling favour at reception
displayForm: Would you mind covering reception from two until three while I meet the supplier? I'd really appreciate it, and I can cover your last hour tomorrow.

ru.translation: Не мог(ла) бы ты подменить меня на стойке регистрации с двух до трёх, пока я встречаюсь с поставщиком? Я буду очень признателен(на) и завтра смогу подменить тебя в последний час.
ru.usageNote: Variation v1 transfers the favour from checking a task to a scheduling exchange with a reciprocal offer.

examples.text: Would you mind covering reception from two until three while I meet the supplier? I'd really appreciate it, and I can cover your last hour tomorrow.

npcReplyCorrect: That exchange works for me. I'll cover reception at two, and you can take my last hour tomorrow.

lemma: ask for help preparing meeting notes
displayForm: Would you mind turning my meeting notes into a short update for the team? I need to deal with the supplier problem this afternoon.

ru.translation: Не мог(ла) бы ты превратить мои заметки со встречи в короткое обновление для команды? Сегодня днём мне нужно заняться проблемой с поставщиком.
ru.usageNote: Variation v2 changes the type of help and creates a real condition to negotiate.

examples.text: Would you mind turning my meeting notes into a short update for the team? I need to deal with the supplier problem this afternoon.

npcReplyCorrect: I can do that if you send me the final notes before lunch. Is that possible?

lemma: accept a condition on a workplace favour
displayForm: Yes, I'll send them by eleven. Could you keep the update to one page and send it before four?

ru.translation: Да, я отправлю их до одиннадцати. Можешь ограничить обновление одной страницей и прислать его до четырёх?
ru.usageNote: The learner accepts Daniel's condition, then clarifies output and deadline rather than simply repeating the favour.

examples.text: Yes, I'll send them by eleven. Could you keep the update to one page and send it before four?

npcReplyCorrect: Agreed. Once the notes arrive, I'll prepare a one-page update and send it before four.

displayForm: I've worked in this field for three years. I mainly support customers, and I currently coordinate the morning shift.

ru.translation: Я работаю в поддержке клиентов три года и сейчас координирую утреннюю смену.
ru.usageNote: The exact V2 Present Perfect experience phrase anchors a relevant, concise interview answer.

examples.text: I've worked in this field for three years. I mainly support customers, and I currently coordinate the morning shift.

npcReplyCorrect: That experience is relevant to the coordinator role. What would you say is your main strength at work?

lemma: support an interview strength with an example
displayForm: My main strength is staying organised when several requests arrive at once. For example, I created a shared priority list for my team.

ru.translation: Моя главная сильная сторона — сохранять организованность, когда одновременно поступает несколько запросов. Например, я создал(а) общий список приоритетов для команды.
ru.usageNote: The learner gives evidence for the strength instead of listing an unsupported quality.

examples.text: My main strength is staying organised when several requests arrive at once. For example, I created a shared priority list for my team.

npcReplyCorrect: A clear priority system would help this team. Why are you interested in moving into this role now?

lemma: explain interest in an internal role
displayForm: I'm interested in this role because I enjoy helping colleagues work together, and I want more responsibility for planning.

ru.translation: Меня интересует эта роль, потому что мне нравится помогать коллегам работать вместе и я хочу взять больше ответственности за планирование.
ru.usageNote: The because-clause links motivation directly to the role rather than adding an unrelated personal fact.

examples.text: I'm interested in this role because I enjoy helping colleagues work together, and I want more responsibility for planning.

npcReplyCorrect: Thank you. Your support experience, practical example and reason for applying give me a clear picture.

lemma: interview for a technical support role
displayForm: I've helped colleagues with software problems for two years. My strength is explaining steps clearly, and I'm interested in the support role because I enjoy solving practical problems.

ru.translation: Я два года помогаю коллегам с проблемами в программах. Моя сильная сторона — ясно объяснять шаги, а эта роль в поддержке интересует меня, потому что мне нравится решать практические задачи.
ru.usageNote: Variation v1 transfers the interview structure to a support role with different experience, strength and motivation.

examples.text: I've helped colleagues with software problems for two years. My strength is explaining steps clearly, and I'm interested in the support role because I enjoy solving practical problems.

npcReplyCorrect: Those examples fit the support role well, especially the clear explanations. Thank you.

lemma: answer why the company should choose you
displayForm: You should choose me because I've already coordinated busy shifts, and I know how to keep the team informed when plans change.

ru.translation: Вам стоит выбрать меня, потому что я уже координировал(а) загруженные смены и умею держать команду в курсе, когда планы меняются.
ru.usageNote: Variation v2 answers Daniel's harder question with relevant evidence; should is recycled, not a new target.

examples.text: You should choose me because I've already coordinated busy shifts, and I know how to keep the team informed when plans change.

npcReplyCorrect: That is a focused answer: you connected real experience to the main challenge of this role.

displayForm: Let's find a time that works for everyone. I'm free on Saturday afternoon, and Maya said she is too.

ru.translation: Давай найдём время, которое подходит всем. Я свободен(на) в субботу днём, и Майя сказала, что она тоже.
ru.usageNote: The learner starts with known availability and the frozen group-coordination chunk.

examples.text: Let's find a time that works for everyone. I'm free on Saturday afternoon, and Maya said she is too.

npcReplyCorrect: Daniel is working until four on Saturday, but he can come afterwards. What time should we suggest?

lemma: suggest a group time and practical location
displayForm: What if we meet at five? We could have dinner near the station so Daniel can join us after work.

ru.translation: Что, если встретиться в пять? Мы могли бы поужинать возле вокзала, чтобы Дэниел присоединился после работы.
ru.usageNote: What if introduces a concrete solution to Daniel's constraint; could is recycled suggestion language.

examples.text: What if we meet at five? We could have dinner near the station so Daniel can join us after work.

npcReplyCorrect: Five works for Daniel. Maya needs to leave by seven, so a place near the station would suit her too. Which place should we choose?

lemma: choose a venue and check with the group
displayForm: The café beside the station has a large table. I'll check with Maya and Daniel and book it if they agree.

ru.translation: В кафе рядом с вокзалом есть большой стол. Я уточню у Майи и Дэниела и забронирую его, если они согласятся.
ru.usageNote: I'll check with is the frozen coordination phrase; if they agree is a real first-conditional decision step.

examples.text: The café beside the station has a large table. I'll check with Maya and Daniel and book it if they agree.

npcReplyCorrect: Good plan. Daniel also asked whether Emma could come. Will the table be large enough for four?

lemma: confirm the group arrangement and final participant
displayForm: Yes, it seats four. We're meeting there at five on Saturday, and I'll ask Emma today before I confirm the table.

ru.translation: Да, там четыре места. Мы встречаемся там в пять в субботу, и сегодня я приглашу Эмму, прежде чем подтвержу стол.
ru.usageNote: Present Continuous confirms the arrangement; will reports the learner's immediate coordination decision.

examples.text: Yes, it seats four. We're meeting there at five on Saturday, and I'll ask Emma today before I confirm the table.

npcReplyCorrect: Perfect. We have a time, a place and the guest list; send me the confirmation once Emma replies.

displayForm: Let's find a time that works for everyone. What if we take the nine o'clock train on Sunday and meet at the station entrance at quarter to nine? I'll check with Maya and Daniel before I buy the group tickets.

ru.translation: Давай найдём время, которое подходит всем. Что, если поехать на девятичасовом поезде в воскресенье и встретиться у входа на вокзал без четверти девять? Я уточню у Майи и Дэниела, прежде чем покупать групповые билеты.
ru.usageNote: Variation v1 transfers coordination from dinner to a trip with departure, meeting point and ticket dependency.

examples.text: Let's find a time that works for everyone. What if we take the nine o'clock train on Sunday and meet at the station entrance at quarter to nine? I'll check with Maya and Daniel before I buy the group tickets.

npcReplyCorrect: That covers the important details. Ask them tonight so we can still get the cheaper group tickets.

lemma: propose a first group time with a constraint
displayForm: What if we meet for lunch at one on Saturday? Maya and Emma are free then, and the market café takes group bookings.

ru.translation: Что, если встретиться на обед в час в субботу? Майя и Эмма в это время свободны, а кафе на рынке принимает групповые бронирования.
ru.usageNote: Variation v2 establishes a valid first proposal before Alex introduces one participant's conflict.

examples.text: What if we meet for lunch at one on Saturday? Maya and Emma are free then, and the market café takes group bookings.

npcReplyCorrect: Maya and Emma can make it, but Daniel has a class until two. Could we move it later without losing the table?

lemma: revise a group plan after one conflict
displayForm: Then what if we book the table for half past two? I'll check with everyone again, and we're meeting outside the café at two twenty if they agree.

ru.translation: Тогда что, если забронировать стол на половину третьего? Я ещё раз уточню у всех, и, если они согласятся, мы встречаемся у кафе в два двадцать.
ru.usageNote: The learner responds to the conflict by revising both booking and meeting time, then reconfirms the group.

examples.text: Then what if we book the table for half past two? I'll check with everyone again, and we're meeting outside the café at two twenty if they agree.

npcReplyCorrect: That solves Daniel's conflict and still gives us the afternoon together. I'll hold the table while you check.

displayForm: I'd love to come to Maya's dinner, but I'm visiting my sister that evening.

ru.translation: Я бы с удовольствием пришёл/пришла на ужин Майи, но в тот вечер я навещаю сестру.
ru.usageNote: I'd love to, but is the frozen target: interest first, genuine reason second.

examples.text: I'd love to come to Maya's dinner, but I'm visiting my sister that evening.

npcReplyCorrect: I understand. Maya also mentioned a picnic on Sunday. Would that work for you?

displayForm: I work on Sunday morning too. How about coffee with Maya on Saturday instead of the picnic?

ru.translation: В воскресенье утром я тоже работаю. Как насчёт кофе с Майей в субботу вместо пикника?
ru.usageNote: Instead of replaces the declined plan with a concrete alternative rather than ending the conversation.

examples.text: I work on Sunday morning too. How about coffee with Maya on Saturday instead of the picnic?

npcReplyCorrect: Saturday could work. Maya is free after three; what time should I suggest?

displayForm: Four o'clock would be great. Could you ask her, or should I message her myself?

ru.translation: Четыре часа было бы отлично. Ты спросишь её или мне написать ей самому/самой?
ru.usageNote: The learner helps complete the alternative plan instead of repeating the refusal.

examples.text: Four o'clock would be great. Could you ask her, or should I message her myself?

npcReplyCorrect: I'll ask her now and copy you into the message, so you can confirm directly.

lemma: decline a work event in an appropriate register
displayForm: I'd love to join your studio talk, but I'm presenting our project that afternoon. How about meeting the speakers for coffee the next morning instead of attending the talk?

ru.translation: Я бы с удовольствием пришёл/пришла на встречу в твоей студии, но в тот день я представляю наш проект. Как насчёт кофе со спикерами на следующее утро вместо самой встречи?
ru.usageNote: Variation v1 transfers the refusal to a work event and a more formal practical alternative.

examples.text: I'd love to join your studio talk, but I'm presenting our project that afternoon. How about meeting the speakers for coffee the next morning instead of attending the talk?

npcReplyCorrect: That is a useful alternative. The speakers are staying nearby, so I'll ask whether Friday morning suits them.

lemma: decline a concert without damaging the relationship
displayForm: I'd love to come to the concert, but I can't make Saturday. Maybe another time?

ru.translation: Я бы с удовольствием пришёл/пришла на концерт, но в субботу не смогу. Может быть, в другой раз?
ru.usageNote: Variation v2 begins with a warm refusal before Alex asks for a fuller reason.

examples.text: I'd love to come to the concert, but I can't make Saturday. Maybe another time?

npcReplyCorrect: That's a shame. Is the late finish difficult, or do you already have plans?

lemma: give a longer reason and preserve the invitation
displayForm: I already promised to help my parents move that day, and it may take all evening. How about the outdoor concert next month instead?

ru.translation: Я уже обещал(а) помочь родителям с переездом в тот день, и это может занять весь вечер. Как насчёт концерта на открытом воздухе в следующем месяце?
ru.usageNote: The learner answers Alex's follow-up with a fuller reason and a new shared plan.

examples.text: I already promised to help my parents move that day, and it may take all evening. How about the outdoor concert next month instead?

npcReplyCorrect: That makes sense. I'll check the date of the outdoor concert and send it to you tonight.

lemma: explain a service problem from the beginning
displayForm: Let me explain from the start. I ordered a desk lamp on Monday. The parcel arrived without the base, and after I used the chat, the warehouse sent another cable instead.

ru.translation: Позвольте объяснить с самого начала. В понедельник я заказал(а) настольную лампу. Посылка пришла без основания, а после обращения в чат склад вместо него отправил ещё один кабель.
ru.usageNote: The frozen opening chunk organizes a multi-step history without introducing above-B1 grammar.

examples.text: Let me explain from the start. I ordered a desk lamp on Monday. The parcel arrived without the base, and after I used the chat, the warehouse sent another cable instead.

npcReplyCorrect: I can see both records. The chat request says 'cable missing', so the warehouse followed that note. Let me check how to correct it.

displayForm: So what you're saying is that the wrong part was recorded first, and I need a new request for the base. Is that right?

ru.translation: То есть вы говорите, что сначала записали неверную деталь и теперь нужен новый запрос на основание. Верно?
ru.usageNote: Reported confirmation is an explicit frozen target used to verify Emma's explanation.

examples.text: So what you're saying is that the wrong part was recorded first, and I need a new request for the base. Is that right?

npcReplyCorrect: Exactly. I can either arrange a collection for the whole lamp or send the missing base separately on Friday.

displayForm: First, please cancel the incorrect cable request. Then send the base to my work address. That should work because someone will be there on Friday.

ru.translation: Сначала отмените ошибочный запрос на кабель. Затем отправьте основание на мой рабочий адрес. Это должно сработать, потому что в пятницу там кто-нибудь будет.
ru.usageNote: First/then/so language turns the options into an agreed step-by-step solution; that should work is the frozen resolution chunk.

examples.text: First, please cancel the incorrect cable request. Then send the base to my work address. That should work because someone will be there on Friday.

npcReplyCorrect: Done. The cable request is cancelled, and the base will go to your work address under reference L-284.

lemma: explain a delivery problem in a new domain
displayForm: Let me explain from the start. The courier marked my book parcel as delivered, but the photo shows a different building, and none of my neighbours has it.

ru.translation: Позвольте объяснить с самого начала. Курьер отметил посылку с книгами как доставленную, но на фото другое здание, и ни у кого из соседей её нет.
ru.usageNote: Variation v1 changes a parts error into a delivery-location investigation.

examples.text: Let me explain from the start. The courier marked my book parcel as delivered, but the photo shows a different building, and none of my neighbours has it.

npcReplyCorrect: The door number in the photo is 18, but your address is 80. I can ask the courier to retrieve it or send a replacement today.

lemma: confirm and choose the delivery solution
displayForm: So the parcel went to number 18, not 80. First, please contact the courier; then send a replacement if they cannot collect it today. That should work.

ru.translation: То есть посылка попала в дом 18, а не 80. Сначала свяжитесь с курьером, затем отправьте замену, если сегодня забрать её не получится. Это должно сработать.
ru.usageNote: The learner confirms the new facts and orders two conditional service steps.

examples.text: So the parcel went to number 18, not 80. First, please contact the courier; then send a replacement if they cannot collect it today. That should work.

npcReplyCorrect: Agreed. I'll call the courier now and email you by four; if they cannot recover it, the replacement will leave today.

displayForm: Hello, this is Anna Kowalski. I'm calling about order L-4821. The lamp arrived today without its base. Please call me back on 07123 445566 so we can arrange the missing part. Thank you.

ru.translation: Здравствуйте, это Анна Ковальски. Я звоню по поводу заказа L-4821. Лампа пришла сегодня без основания. Пожалуйста, перезвоните мне по номеру 07123 445566, чтобы мы организовали доставку недостающей детали. Спасибо.
ru.usageNote: Voicemail modality includes name, order, exact problem and callback request without visual cues or live negotiation.

examples.text: Hello, this is Anna Kowalski. I'm calling about order L-4821. The lamp arrived today without its base. Please call me back on 07123 445566 so we can arrange the missing part. Thank you.

npcReplyCorrect: Thanks for the clear message, Anna. I found order L-4821 and can arrange the missing base when you return my call.

lemma: acknowledge policy and state the unresolved claim
displayForm: I understand the deposit policy, but I still think the deposit should be returned. We cancelled before the deadline in the confirmation email.

ru.translation: Я понимаю правило о депозите, но всё же считаю, что депозит нужно вернуть. Мы отменили бронь до срока, указанного в письме-подтверждении.
ru.usageNote: I understand, but I still is the explicit concessive-persistence target, not a light exposure.

examples.text: I understand the deposit policy, but I still think the deposit should be returned. We cancelled before the deadline in the confirmation email.

npcReplyCorrect: Our booking screen shows the cancellation at five ten, ten minutes after the deadline, so I cannot release it from this screen.

displayForm: I see the timestamp, but my cancellation email was sent at four forty-five. Could we find another way to check when it reached your system?

ru.translation: Я вижу отметку времени, но моё письмо об отмене было отправлено в 4:45. Можно ли как-то иначе проверить, когда оно поступило в вашу систему?
ru.usageNote: The learner answers Leo's exact objection with evidence; could we find another way is a frozen persistence chunk.

examples.text: I see the timestamp, but my cancellation email was sent at four forty-five. Could we find another way to check when it reached your system?

npcReplyCorrect: I can ask the manager to check the email log. It may take two working days before we know which timestamp is correct.

displayForm: Two days is fine, but I'd really like this resolved before the card charge closes on Friday. Could you ask the manager today and email me the decision?

ru.translation: Два дня подходят, но мне очень хотелось бы решить вопрос до закрытия карточного списания в пятницу. Можете сегодня обратиться к менеджеру и прислать решение по электронной почте?
ru.usageNote: I'd really like this resolved is the frozen goal-focused chunk; the request remains calm and specific.

examples.text: Two days is fine, but I'd really like this resolved before the card charge closes on Friday. Could you ask the manager today and email me the decision?

npcReplyCorrect: Yes. I'll send the manager the email record today and confirm the decision to you before Friday.

lemma: persist when a restaurant table is needed back
displayForm: I understand you need this table for the next booking, but my grandfather cannot use the bar seats. Could we move somewhere else while we finish dessert?

ru.translation: Я понимаю, что этот стол нужен для следующей брони, но мой дедушка не может сидеть у бара. Можно ли нам пересесть в другое место, пока мы заканчиваем десерт?
ru.usageNote: Corrected v1 keeps Leo and the restaurant scene while transferring persistence from billing to an accessibility constraint.

examples.text: I understand you need this table for the next booking, but my grandfather cannot use the bar seats. Could we move somewhere else while we finish dessert?

npcReplyCorrect: The bar is the only indoor space I have, and the next guests will arrive in ten minutes.

lemma: persist with a workable restaurant alternative
displayForm: I appreciate that, but the bar still won't work for him. Could we find another way? We'd be happy to move to the covered terrace.

ru.translation: Я это понимаю, но бар ему всё равно не подойдёт. Можно ли найти другой вариант? Мы с удовольствием пересядем на крытую террасу.
ru.usageNote: The learner holds the position after Leo's resistance and proposes a practical compromise.

examples.text: I appreciate that, but the bar still won't work for him. Could we find another way? We'd be happy to move to the covered terrace.

npcReplyCorrect: The covered terrace is available and has suitable chairs. I'll move your desserts there and keep the heater on.

lemma: challenge an unexpected service fee politely
displayForm: I understand the cake service usually costs extra, but our booking email says it is included in the birthday package. I'd really like the fee removed.

ru.translation: Я понимаю, что подача торта обычно оплачивается отдельно, но в нашем письме о бронировании сказано, что она входит в праздничный пакет. Я хотел(а) бы, чтобы сбор убрали.
ru.usageNote: Variation v2 starts a new evidence-based dispute and requires two rounds of calm persistence.

examples.text: I understand the cake service usually costs extra, but our booking email says it is included in the birthday package. I'd really like the fee removed.

npcReplyCorrect: The printed package at reception does not include cake service, so I can only reduce the fee by two pounds.

lemma: answer the first pushback with a verification request
displayForm: I appreciate the reduction, but the written confirmation says 'no extra service fee'. Could you check the booking note as well?

ru.translation: Спасибо за снижение суммы, но в письменном подтверждении сказано «без дополнительного сбора за обслуживание». Можете также проверить примечание к брони?
ru.usageNote: The learner acknowledges Leo's offer, keeps the claim and asks for a specific second check.

examples.text: I appreciate the reduction, but the written confirmation says 'no extra service fee'. Could you check the booking note as well?

npcReplyCorrect: The booking note mentions the birthday package but not the cake. I could remove half the remaining fee as a compromise.

lemma: persist through a second round of resistance
displayForm: Thank you, but half the fee still doesn't match the confirmation we received. Could we find another way to honour the written offer?

ru.translation: Спасибо, но половина сбора всё равно не соответствует полученному подтверждению. Можно ли найти другой способ выполнить письменное предложение?
ru.usageNote: The final turn maintains a polite position after two pushbacks without escalating beyond B1.

examples.text: Thank you, but half the fee still doesn't match the confirmation we received. Could we find another way to honour the written offer?

npcReplyCorrect: You're right that the written offer should be honoured. I'll remove the full service fee and print a corrected bill.
